subject.title: Feature Request: Add 'description' field to agent config for dynamic agent discovery

question: Should OpenClaw expose operator-authored `agents.list[].description` values through the agent-visible `agents_list` tool as the supported discovery contract?
rationale: Current main accepts the config field, but surfacing it to agent tool output is a product/security boundary choice because it changes prompt-visible metadata and the issue already has an open implementation PR waiting on that direction.

options.title: Expose bounded descriptions
options.body: Land or adapt the open PR so `agents_list` returns trimmed nonblank descriptions with docs and tests for omission and prompt-size/security expectations.

options.title: Keep config-only metadata
options.body: Document that `description` is stored/preserved metadata only and close or narrow the linked PR so agents do not receive it through `agents_list`.

options.title: Use a broader discovery design
options.body: Fold this into a larger sibling-agent discovery surface such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/52146 instead of adding the field directly to `agents_list`.

recommendation.title: Expose bounded descriptions
recommendation.body: Land or adapt the open PR so `agents_list` returns trimmed nonblank descriptions with docs and tests for omission and prompt-size/security expectations.

likelyOwner.reason: The code history ties this agent discovery/tool surface most strongly to Peter Steinberger’s prior `agents_list` and multi-agent runtime work.
